scripts.fonts:install: mkdir -p src/fonts && curl -fL https://github.com/RuneStar/fonts/releases/download/1.103-0/RuneScape-Fonts.zip -o src/fonts/fonts.zip && unzip -jo src/fonts/fonts.zip 'ttf/RuneScape-Plain-11.ttf' 'ttf/RuneScape-Plain-12.ttf' 'ttf/RuneScape-Bold-12.ttf' -d src/fonts && rm src/fonts/fonts.zip
